title: Apple extends free satellite features for older iPhones
description: A footnote in the iPhone 18 Pro press release revealed that Apple is providing an additional year of free satellite features for older iPhones. This means users with compatible iPhone models dating back to 2022’s iPhone 14 series will be able to enjoy Emergency SOS via satellite, Messages via satellite, Find My via satellite, and Roadside Assistance via satellite free of charge for at least one more year. The only requirement is that the devices need to be activated before September 9, 2026. This development marks the third time that Cupertino is extending free satellite access for the...

title: Samsung’s Galaxy Buds On leak again
description: Samsung is working on a pair of open-ear clip-on wireless earbuds which are expected to launch as the Galaxy Buds On, and we now have our first official-looking renders complete with additional details thanks to a new report from SammyGuru. Samsung Galaxy Buds On (images: SammyGuru) Just as the previous renders show, Galaxy Buds On feature a two-part design with one side featuring the speaker and the other sitting behind the ear. The two sides are connected with a silicone loop, and we can also spot pogo-pin connectors, which will charge the buds when they are placed inside their...

title: Honor Watch 6 Pro's launch date and design revealed
description: Honor's Watch 6 series includes the Watch 6, Watch 6 Plus, and Watch 6 Plus Motorcycle Edition. Honor has announced that the Watch 6 Pro will join them on September 28. Honor posted a teaser on Weibo that also revealed the Watch 6 Pro's design. It shows two versions - one with a sporty look and another with a formal design. The smartwatch also has a couple of physical buttons on its right side for different actions. In addition to revealing the design, the teaser confirmed that the Watch 6 Pro will come with cardiac arrest monitoring and blood pressure monitoring. The Honor Watch...

title: Poco X8 Power with a 10,000mAh battery goes on sale in India
description: The Poco X8 was unveiled globally earlier this month, followed by its India launch alongside the X8 Power last week. The Poco X8 Power comes with a massive 10,000mAh battery and is now available for purchase in the country. It’s priced at INR 35,999 ($375) for the 8GB/128GB variant, whereas the 8GB/256GB model carries a price tag of INR 38,999 ($410). The X8 Power is being offered in Black and Yellow colorways. Aside from the large 10,000mAh battery, the Poco X8 Power comes with a 6.83-inch OLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, up to 3,200 nits peak brightness, and a 1.5K...

title: Honor Magic9 series said to include a Super Edition with an 11,000mAh battery
description: Honor recently revealed the design of its upcoming Magic9 series but did not share any specs. A recent leak suggested that Honor would launch two models, but a new one now claims that the lineup will include the base Magic9, Magic9 Pro Max, and a Magic9 Super Edition. According to a tipster on Weibo, the entire Honor Magic9 series will use the same rear camera design showcased in recent official renders. The tipster claims that the Magic9 Super Edition will feature a 6.8-inch display with a 165Hz refresh rate. It is said to pack a 200MP primary rear camera alongside 12MP and 50MP...

title: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag3's leaked images reveal design and colors
description: Samsung launched the OG Galaxy SmartTag in 2021 and followed it with the SmartTag2 in 2023. We know Samsung is preparing to launch the third-gen SmartTag soon. Its illustrations that leaked in July revealed the tracker would come in a squircle-like shape. Now we are looking at leaked images of the Galaxy SmartTag3, giving us our first look at it. The images show the Samsung Galaxy SmartTag3 in two colors and reveal the tracker won't have a hole for a lanyard or keyring, so you'll have to shell out extra money for a separate case with an attachment loop if you want to attach the SmartTag3...

title: Here's your first look at the upcoming iQOO 16
description: After teasing the iQOO 16’s redesigned rear camera module earlier this week, the company has now offered a closer look at the phone’s overall rear design. The handset will debut later this month alongside the iQOO Pad Ultra. The iQOO 16’s square-shaped rear camera module features a raised lip surrounding the triple-camera setup, which is arranged in a unique layout. The LED flash is positioned in the top-right corner, outside the module, while the “100x Tele” text is printed inside the camera island. The raised lip appears to offer some added protection to the camera lenses, which...

title: Oppo K14 Lite is coming, launch date and design revealed
description: Oppo's K14 series currently includes two smartphones - the K14 and the K14x. Next week, these will be joined by a new member, as Oppo today announced it will unveil the K14 Lite in India on September 16 at 12 PM local time. Oppo says the K14 Lite is "designed for users who seek reliable everyday performance and a smartphone that keeps up with their daily routines." While Oppo didn't detail the K14 Lite's spec sheet, it confirmed the smartphone will pack a 7,000 mAh battery. Moreover, the images Oppo shared revealed the K14 Lite's design and color options. Oppo will sell the K14 Lite...

title: vivo X Fold6's global launch is nearing
description: vivo launched its latest foldable smartphone, the X Fold6, in China back in June. We've been patiently waiting for it to go global ever since, and while that still hasn’t happened yet, it seems like it's just around the corner now. That's because someone in possession of a global X Fold6 prototype has decided to run Geekbench on it earlier today. The global X Fold6 has the model number V2559. It managed a single-core score of 1,710 and a multi-core score of 5,977 in Geekbench 7.0.0 for Android, as you can see in the screenshot below. Obviously as this is a prototype device, you...

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra now available in India as part of Certified Re-Newed program
description: Samsung has announced that the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra are now available in India through its Certified Re-Newed (CRN) program. Samsung claims that every CRN device is "inspected, cleaned, refurbished and tested through a Samsung-certified renewal process to meet Samsung’s standards for quality, performance and reliability." Each CRN device is reset to remove personal data and updated with the latest software before being sold to customers. It also packs a Samsung-certified battery, and where required, parts are replaced with genuine Samsung parts. The CRN Galaxy S26 and...

title: Xiaomi starts beta test recruitment for HyperOS 4
description: Xiaomi is now starting to recruit eager beta testers for its upcoming HyperOS 4 release for Global and EEA markets. If you want to give it a try, as always do keep in mind that beta software can have bugs and issues and is not recommended for your daily driver. If you want to go through with it even so, then you need to have a Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Leica Leitzphone by Xiaomi, or Xiaomi 17. Then, head on over to the Xiaomi Community app, tap Me, then Beta testing, and then Recruiting test. There will be a questionnaire for you to fill out. Xiaomi notes that for certain beta versions,...

title: Qualcomm outlines the improvements in the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro's new NPU
description: Qualcomm is introducing its Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC as well as the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro at its annual Snapdragon Summit on September 22. Ahead of that event, today the company is teasing the improvements it's made to one of the chips' Hexagon NPU (presumably we're talking about the Hexagon NPU of the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro). This is built for agentic AI, with a transformer-focused Element Accelerator and a 50% larger shared memory that "keeps frequently accessed model data close to the NPU" so that agents "can stay responsive as they juggle longer context, more...

title: Here are the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max Geekbench scores
description: Yesterday, Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, which are both powered by the new A20 Pro chip. As usual, the company has praised its latest and greatest SoC for being better than all of its predecessors, but how does it actually perform in a benchmark? Thankfully, we have a preliminary answer for that today, since two new iPhones identifying themselves as the iPhone 19,2 and iPhone 19,3 have just run Geekbench 6.7. Their single-core scores are 4,719 and 4,612, respectively, while their multi-core scores are 12,677 and 11,819, respectively. If we average the single-core...

title: Insta360 Luna Pro gimbal camera goes official with a 1-inch sensor
description: Insta360 is expanding its Luna series of gimbal cameras with the new Luna Pro. The handheld gimbal camera features a 1-inch sensor paired with a Leica Summicron lens, along with support for 8K Dolby Vision video recording and 10-bit I-Log. The Insta360 Luna Pro is powered by a 4nm chipset and also features a dedicated image processor, enabling its 1-inch sensor to capture video at up to 8K resolution and up to 1080p 240fps slow-motion footage. The gimbal camera features 3-axis stabilization, along with 2x lossless zoom and up to 4x HighRes zoom. The Luna Pro also features a...

title: Apple iPhone Duo vs. iPhone 18 Pro (Max): Which one to get?
description: Apple’s relatively stable smartphone line-up made it easy for people to figure out their upgrade path. The company would occasionally throw in a curveball like the iPhone Air or the iPhone 17e, but for the most part, people didn’t spend much time wondering which model to pick. Vanilla users got the new vanilla iPhone, Pro users got the new Pro. But now the iPhone Duo has arrived, Apple’s first foldable. Obviously, Android foldables have been around for a while now, so this isn’t a completely unprecedented experience. Still, for Apple die-hards this could be their first...

title: The Trump phone just got 50% more expensive
description: The Trump Mobile T1 Phone, announced with much fanfare (how else) last year, finally became available this June for $499. And if you wanted one, hopefully you were able to get it at that price. Now you can't. That's because the device has quietly received a sharp price increase up to a whopping $749. That's 50% more than it used to be, and considering the fact that this is just an HTC from 2024 with a gold paint job and Trump logo on it, well, let's just say you really need to be a huge Trump fan to justify the new price. There are many better-specced phones out there for the same...

title: Apple reveals the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max's battery capacities
description: Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, and today the company has done something that it really doesn't enjoy doing: publishing actual specs. Thanks to the EU, Apple has to make the phone's Energy Labels public, which it did today. You can see them below. This means we now know what the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max's battery capacities are in the EU. The former gets a 4,056 mAh cell, the latter a 5,391 mAh battery. These are rated capacity numbers, not the typical capacity that phone makers advertise, so it's hard to compare them directly to the previous...

title: TrendForce: Apple to capture a quarter of the folding phone market in 2026
description: Following yesterday’s iPhone Duo announcement, TrendForce published a new report that outlines the state of the foldable phone market for 2027. According to the report, Apple will ship 5 million units of its folding phone by the end of the year. If this prediction turns out to be true, then Cupertino would be sitting at a 24.8% market share, which would slot it in second place, right behind Samsung. Global folding phone shipments are expected to reach 20.2 million units in 2026, which would make for a 0.5% rise compared to 2025. The upward trend with folding phones is then...

title: Here are the Apple iPhone Duo alternatives
description: Apple finally did it – it unveiled its first foldable phone and it is called the iPhone Duo. Arriving many years after the first foldables became available means that the Duo is entering a heavily contested market. Or is it? The Duo is the third kind of foldable. The first is the large book-style foldables pioneered by the Royole Flexpai and the Galaxy Fold. Shortly after arrived the second kind, the flip phone style, which was suitably introduced by the Motorola Razr. The Duo is a wide foldable, a relatively recent introduction. Samsung Galaxy Fold • Motorola Razr 2019 What...

title: Motorola starts teasing its own wide foldable smartphone in response to the iPhone Duo
description: A few days ago some sketches leaked purportedly showing a wide foldable smartphone from Motorola, that was allegedly due to be released "in the coming months". Now, as a response to Apple's launch of the iPhone Duo, Motorola has officially started teasing the device on its X account. You can just about see it at the end of the video below, right after the Razr Fold. That feeling when you hang up, and your razr says everything you didn’t. 😏Some are just discovering it.
